assessments.decision: Northwind Labs provides full-time staff with 20 days of paid leave per year under version 3 of the leave policy.
assessments.why: The new decision grants 30 days of paid leave per year, which conflicts with the existing decision granting 20 days per year.

assessments.decision: Northwind Labs does not allow unused paid leave days to carry over to the next year.
assessments.why: The new decision addresses the number of paid leave days per year, which is a different topic from the carry-over of unused days.

assessments.decision: Production deploys happen only on Tuesday and Thursday mornings, 09:00 to 11:00 Singapore time.
assessments.why: The new decision is about paid leave for full-time staff, which is completely unrelated to production deployment schedules.
